$comment: Wave two of the cross-platform contract for Stance AI components. Read specs/ai-components.json first: its principles, shared generation status and motion tokens apply here unchanged.
principles: People stay in control. Anything an agent wants to do that changes data, spends money or leaves the product goes through an explicit approval with a clear description of the effect.
Show the work. Steps, tools and sources are visible and can be expanded, never hidden behind a spinner.
Every AI change can be reviewed before it lands and undone after.
AI inside a product is quiet. Suggestions never move focus, never block typing and are dismissed with Escape.
Generated content is rendered safely: Markdown is parsed to elements, never injected as raw HTML; links are plain navigations; images need alt text.

components.name: ToolCallCard
components.summary: One tool call by the assistant: what it ran, with what input, and what came back.
components.a11y: A disclosure. Status is in the accessible name, for example Search the web, complete. Status changes are announced once.

components.name: StepTimeline
components.summary: The ordered steps of an agent run, with the current step marked and each step expandable.
props: steps: { id, title, description?, status: StepStatus, duration?, content? }[]
components.a11y: An ordered list. The running step uses aria-current=step. Step status is text, never colour alone.

components.name: PlanChecklist
components.summary: The plan an agent proposes before it starts: steps that can be reviewed, edited, reordered or removed, then approved.
props: items: { id, title, description?, status: StepStatus }[]
components.a11y: A list with a progress summary. Reorder has move up and move down actions as well as drag.

components.name: ApprovalPrompt
components.summary: Asks for permission before the agent acts. States the action, its effect and the risk, with allow, allow always and deny.
props: details (node, for example the command or the diff)
countdown (optional seconds for auto deny, never auto allow)
components.a11y: An alertdialog style group that takes focus when it appears inline only if requested; deny is the safe default for Escape. High risk requires an explicit press, Enter never allows by default.

components.name: PermissionSheet
components.summary: A sheet listing what an agent or connector may access, with a switch for each permission and a clear scope.
props: permissions: { id, title, description?, granted, required?, risk? }[]
components.a11y: A dialog with a labelled group of switches. Required permissions are disabled and explained.

components.name: AgentStatusPill
components.summary: A compact pill showing what an agent is doing now: idle, working, waiting for you, done or failed.
props: status: idle | working | waiting | done | error | paused
components.a11y: A status, or a button when pressable. Waiting for you is announced assertively once; the rest politely.

components.name: TaskQueue
components.summary: The tasks an agent has queued, running and finished, with pause, cancel and retry on each.
props: tasks: { id, title, status: StepStatus, progress?, detail?, startedAt? }[]
components.a11y: A list with a count summary. Each action names its task.

components.name: SubagentTree
components.summary: A tree of an agent and the agents it has delegated to, each with status and a one line summary.
props: nodes: { id, name, status, summary?, children? }[]
components.a11y: A tree with the standard arrow key model. Status is part of each item's name.

components.name: RunLog
components.summary: A live, monospaced log of an agent run that follows the newest line until the reader scrolls up, with level filters and copy.
props: entries: { id, time?, level: info | warn | error | debug, text }[]
components.a11y: A log region. Only errors are announced. Virtualised when long.

components.name: DiffReview
components.summary: Shows a proposed change as a diff, by file or by hunk, with accept and reject for each and for all.
props: files: { id, path, status: added | modified | deleted | renamed, hunks: { id, header?, lines: { kind: add | remove | context, text, oldNumber?, newNumber? }[] }[] }[]
decisions (record of hunk id to accepted | rejected)
components.a11y: Added and removed lines carry a text prefix and a visually hidden word, never colour alone. Each hunk is a group with its own accept and reject. Keyboard moves between hunks.

components.name: MarkdownRenderer
components.summary: Renders model Markdown safely with Stance typography: headings, lists, tables, code, quotes, links and task lists. Tolerates partial Markdown while streaming.
props: citations (map of index to source, renders CitationChip for [n])
components.a11y: Real headings, lists and tables. Heading levels start at a configurable base so the page outline stays valid.

components.name: CodeSuggestion
components.summary: A generated code block with its language and file name, and actions to copy, apply and run, plus the result of a run.
components.a11y: Builds on CodeBlock. Run results are a polite status. Apply confirms with an announcement.

components.name: ArtifactPanel
components.summary: A side panel for a generated document, page or app, with a title, version switcher, preview and code tabs, and actions.
components.a11y: A complementary region with a labelled tablist. Close returns focus to the message that opened it.

components.name: GeneratedImage
components.summary: A generated image with a progressive loading state, variations, and actions to download, regenerate and edit.
components.a11y: Alt text is required. While generating it is a progressbar; variations are a radio style group.

components.name: GeneratedTable
components.summary: A table produced by the assistant, with a caption, sortable columns, copy as CSV and expand to full view.
components.a11y: A real table with a caption and sortable column headers. Rows added while streaming are not announced one by one.

components.name: GeneratedChart
components.summary: A chart the assistant built from data, with a title, a plain language takeaway, a switch to the data table and a source note.
components.a11y: The takeaway is the text alternative. The data table view is always available.

components.name: FilePreviewCard
components.summary: A card for a file the assistant made or used: name, type, size and a preview, with open and download.

components.name: CanvasSplitView
components.summary: Conversation on one side and the working document on the other, resizable on wide screens and switchable on narrow ones.
components.a11y: Two labelled regions. The divider is a separator with arrow key resizing. On narrow screens a tab switch replaces the divider.

components.name: InlineSuggestion
components.summary: Ghost text completion inside a text field. Tab accepts, Escape dismisses, typing continues without interruption.
components.a11y: The suggestion is announced politely with how to accept it. It is never part of the field value until accepted.

components.name: SmartField
components.summary: A form field that AI can fill in. Shows that the value was suggested, where it came from, and lets people undo it.
components.a11y: The suggested state is described in text. Undo is announced. Editing the value clears the AI mark.

components.name: RewriteMenu
components.summary: A menu of ways to change selected text: improve, shorten, lengthen, change tone, translate, or a custom instruction.
components.a11y: A menu with submenus. The preview is a labelled region with replace and discard.

components.name: SummaryCard
components.summary: An AI summary of a longer item with key points, a generated label, sources, and a way to see the original.

components.name: AskBar
components.summary: A single line ask anything bar for a page or a product, with suggestions and an inline answer area.
components.a11y: A search landmark with a combobox for suggestions. The answer is a polite live region when complete.

components.name: SuggestionChips
components.summary: Short follow up prompts or next actions offered after a response or beside content.

components.name: InsightCallout
components.summary: A highlighted finding the system noticed in your data, with the evidence and one suggested action.

components.name: SemanticSearchResults
components.summary: Search results ranked by meaning, each with the matching passage highlighted and why it matched, under an optional AI answer.
props: results: { id, title, href?, snippet, highlights?, source?, score?, reason? }[]
components.a11y: A list of results with a count announced when loading ends. Highlights use mark.

components.name: CopilotPanel
components.summary: A docked assistant panel for a product: a header with context, a thread, and a composer, that opens beside the page or as a sheet on small screens.
components.a11y: A complementary region on wide screens and a dialog on narrow ones. A shortcut opens it and focus goes to the composer; closing returns focus.
